routines.semantics: Close an owned DAS-backed DSK reference. On a writer, true requests DAS segregation and false flushes buffered data before low-level closure. Successful closure invalidates this token. A DSK loaded by furnsh must instead be released with unload or kclear.

routines.edgeAssessment: Exercise both physical close modes on empty and populated DSK writers, read references and duplicate open aliases. A separate locked SpiceyPy process opens each actual two-segment Node/WASM output and verifies ordered vertices, plate topology and center IDs. Retry the same writer workflow on one live client.
routines.errorAssessment: Double close and foreign claims reject at the public ownership boundary. A controlled failed closure leaves its claim live until a successful retry. Both optimized and unsegregated real file closes have durable readback, plus explicit independent kernel cleanup.
